career_spells.evidence_note: A Santos spokesman confirmed employment since October 2015 and strategic-advice duties. Contemporary reporting describes advice on maintaining mainstream political support amid opposition to the CSG industry, states he had no Queensland-government contact in his employee capacity, and says the role was due to end in coming months when campaigning began. This prospective plan is not an actual cessation date. Hours, leave, exact end and continuity remain unresolved. Santos's 2015 report documents shareholder-owned corporate governance, supporting private classification but not individual employment hours.

research_notes: Follow up Santos hours/FTE, actual cessation and leave; clarify pre-2004 paid work, Swan role and dates, and organiser transitions. Do not equate a strategist or adviser title with full-time status.

Initial pass on 2026-09-29 used parliamentary biography/frozen roster, ministerial biography, first speech, Queensland Parliament's March 2015 transcript, employer-confirmation reporting and publicly indexed professional/background searches. Santos-site searches yielded no person-specific employment statement; 2015 annual report URL returned 403. No access restrictions bypassed.

Searches also surfaced an Anthony Chisholm in older economics/Productivity Commission material and the US actor. Identity match to this senator was not established, so those careers are not imported. No verified public professional profile supplying hours was located.

Private-sector classification refers to a commercial resource company; public listing does not mean government control. A historical shareholder/control extract remains a follow-up source, along with primary employment confirmation.

Unspecified or overlapping periods are retained without addition. No qualifying full-time interval is established; both headlines remain null. This is an initial durable record with unresolved gaps, not research completion.

2026-10-02 follow-up: recovered Santos2015 annual report through its ASX filing after earlier employer-hosted403; reviewed shareholder/voting sections and searched person name without match. Added primary classmate/university1996 study commencement. Searches for actual Santos resignation/cessation, employment terms, pre2004 work and Swan position found no reliable additional individual detail. Later political speeches saying until2016/election are broad retrospective assertions, not an exact cessation or proof of continuous full-time work. Keep end null and prior gaps. Original2015–16 Santos employment statement or public CV remains needed. The Griffith oration also supplies Jim Chalmers1996 study-start evidence for his next assigned follow-up; his record was already committed and is not edited in this member commit.

2026-10-03 follow-up: fully reviewed the accessible Guardian article rather than its short index snippet. It supplies employer-confirmed October 2015 commencement, strategic-advice duties and the reported political-support remit; it also records only a prospective end in coming months when the federal campaign began. The duty evidence is added, but the planned cessation is not converted into an actual end date or continuity claim. Searches for a later Santos separation announcement, campaign commencement, full-time terms, Swan staff title and pre-2004 employment found no decisive primary or employer evidence. A 2010 AFR preview and 2011 Courier-Mail preview repeat that Chisholm once worked for Swan but do not resolve role or dates.
